transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because I just haven’t felt like myself lately. The district added this bilingual social-emotional learning rollout on top of my regular teaching, and I’m managing to get through the school day, but I feel really wound up and discouraged. I’ve also started putting off lesson plans and emails—things I used to just handle without thinking much about it.
Are you still enjoying activities that you used to find pleasurable?
I’m not sure I’ve really paid close attention to that. I mean, I still do the things I normally do, but I wouldn’t say I’ve noticed a big change one way or the other.
Are there things that you used to enjoy doing, but now you don't find pleasure in them?
I honestly haven’t noticed anything specific like that. I still do my usual things, and I wouldn’t say they feel completely joyless or anything—I just haven’t really thought about it that closely.
Have you been feeling anxious or on edge lately?

Yes, I have. I feel pretty wound up lately, especially since that bilingual social-emotional learning rollout got added on top of my regular teaching. I’m still getting through the school day, but I feel on edge and discouraged in a way that doesn’t feel like me.
Have you been feeling sad lately?

Yes, I have felt sad—maybe more discouraged than sad, but it’s there. Since the district added that bilingual social-emotional learning rollout on top of my regular teaching, I’m still getting through the day, but I feel wound up and down in a way that doesn’t really feel like me.
Are you avoiding certain situations or tasks because of feeling wound up or discouraged?

Yes, I think I am. I’m still going to work and getting through the day, but I’ve started putting off things like lesson plans and emails—things I used to just handle without really thinking about it. Since this bilingual social-emotional learning rollout got added, I feel wound up and discouraged, and I catch myself avoiding those tasks more.
Have you lost any weight recently?
No, I haven’t really noticed any weight loss. My weight seems about the same.
Have you been feeling more tired than usual lately?
I haven’t really noticed being more tired than usual. I mean, some days feel draining, but I wouldn’t say it’s a big change in my energy.
Have you been having any recurring thoughts or worries that you can't seem to get out of your head?
I’m not sure I’d call them recurring thoughts exactly. I don’t have one thought that’s stuck in my head over and over. I do worry some, but nothing that feels like I can’t get it out of my mind.
Are you avoiding certain social situations?
No, not really. I’m still going to work and seeing people when I need to. I don’t think I’ve been avoiding social situations in any big way.
Have you been having panic attacks lately?
No, I don’t think so. I haven’t had anything I’d call a panic attack lately.
Have you been having any thoughts that keep repeating in your mind, even when you try to focus on something else?
No, I haven’t really noticed that. I can get distracted or worry a bit, but I don’t have thoughts that keep repeating like that when I’m trying to focus.
Do you feel like you're having to repeat certain behaviors over and over?
No, I don’t think so. I haven’t noticed myself needing to repeat things over and over or do certain behaviors like that.
Do you have any thoughts that you feel compelled to think about over and over?
No, not really. I worry about things sometimes, but I don’t feel compelled to keep thinking about the same thing over and over.
Do you have any thoughts that you feel like you can't control?
No, I don’t think so. I have worries sometimes, but I wouldn’t say they feel out of my control.
Do you have any thoughts that keep coming back to you, even when you try to think about something else?
Not really. I mean, I have regular worries come up, but I don’t have thoughts that keep forcing their way back in when I’m trying to think about something else.
Do you have any thoughts that you feel like you're thinking about over and over without wanting to?
No, I don’t think I have that. I might dwell on something for a bit if I’m stressed, but not like I’m stuck thinking it over and over when I don’t want to.
How long have you been feeling wound up and discouraged?
About five months now. It started around when the district assigned me that rollout role in the middle of the school year.
Have you had a period of at least two weeks where you felt sad or empty most of the day?

I don’t think it’s been sad or empty most of the day like that. It’s more that since the district put that bilingual social-emotional learning rollout on me, on top of teaching, I’ve felt wound up and discouraged. I’m still getting through the day, but I’m putting off lesson plans and emails I used to just handle.
Have you had a period of at least two weeks where you felt either sad, empty, or markedly diminished interest or pleasure in most activities most of the day?
I’m not sure I’d describe it that way. I’ve had rough stretches, but I haven’t really noticed a full two weeks where I felt sad or lost interest in most things for most of the day.
